entries.said: Project Spring guidance of investing 12 billion to 16 billion annually through FY30.
entries.quote: in-line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30.
entries.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
entries.delivered: FY26 capex reached INR 14.8 billion, matching the INR 12-16 billion annual target. H1 FY27 capex reached INR 6.1 billion.
entries.evidence: Reported in call c3 for full-year FY26 capex and call c5 for H1 FY27 capex.

entries.said: Project Spring guidance of 11% to 13% for the long term.
entries.quote: to refer to our Project Spring guidance, we've given a long-term guidance of 11% to 13%.
entries.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
entries.delivered: FY26 EBITDA margin was 14.0%, while Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 delivered 13.8% and 14.4%, exceeding 11%-13% guidance.
entries.evidence: Annual and Quarterly reported financials tables.

entries.said: BharatNet scheme is expected to generate 4.5 billion over the next 3 years for project execution.
entries.quote: commenced execution of our existing orders under BharatNet scheme, which is expected to generate ₹ 4.5 billion over the next 3 years
entries.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
entries.delivered: Targeted INR 4.5 billion over 3 years from Jan 2026. Execution progress details are pending in subsequent reports.

entries.said: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.
entries.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.
entries.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
entries.delivered: Target is >10% export contribution by FY30. Requires tracking export revenue share against total revenue through FY30.
entries.evidence: Calls c3 and c4 guidance statements.

entries.said: We are progressing towards our EBITDA margin goal of 8% to 10% in FMEG by FY2030.
entries.quote: and progressing towards our EBITDA margin goal of 8% to 10% by FY2030.
entries.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
entries.delivered: Aims for 8%-10% FMEG EBITDA margin by FY30. FMEG revenue grew 71% YoY in Q1 FY27, but segment EBITDA margin is unstated.
entries.evidence: Calls c3 and c4 reported data.

entries.said: The working capital cycle is expected to settle within the long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.
entries.quote: As these effects normalize, we expect the working capital cycle to settle within our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.
entries.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
entries.delivered: Targeting 45-50 days medium-term. Final working capital days run-rate is not provided in quarterly reporting tables.
entries.evidence: Calls c1, c4, and c5 guidance.

summary: Management is highly reliable on core operational metrics, delivering 13-14%+ EBITDA margins and disciplined capex. Long-term targets (FY30 exports, FMEG margins, EHV plant) remain open and trackable over coming years.
business: Polycab India manufactures and sells Wires and Cables (W&C), Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG), and executes EPC projects.
bull: Consolidated revenue grew strongly by 28.9% in FY26 to Rs 28,884 crore, followed by 52.8% YoY growth in Q2 FY27.
Consolidated EBITDA margins remain healthy at 14.4% in Q2 FY27, outperforming long-term 11%-13% guidance.
Net cash position increased significantly to INR 45.2 billion in Q2 FY27 with FY26 free cash flow reaching Rs 2,340 crore.
bear: FMEG EBITDA margin progress toward the 8%-10% FY30 target is not disclosed separately in reported quarterly segment figures.
Working capital cycle normalization to 45-50 days lacks explicit numerical reporting in available quarterly disclosures.
Executing INR 60-80 billion total 5-year capex plan relies on heavy continuous outlays like INR 14.8 billion spent in FY26.
